name: census-isr-json-automation
description: Census ISR JSON Automation Framework (POC) - Playwright + TypeScript + Cucumber BDD, expected content stored in JSON

scripts.clean:reports: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const d of ['reports/screenshots','reports/traces'])fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});for(const f of ['reports/cucumber-report.html','reports/cucumber-report.json'])fs.rmSync(f,{force:true});"
